sentences.zh: 她喜欢读书。

sentences.en: And she does not much like the color pink.
sentences.zh: 而且她不太喜欢粉色。

sentences.en: You know, I've never really been a pink person.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我从来都不是一个喜欢粉色的人。

sentences.en: On the edge of appreciating purple.
sentences.zh: 勉强能欣赏紫色。

sentences.en: And my favorite color has always been blue.
sentences.zh: 我最喜欢的颜色一直都是蓝色。

sentences.en: And it is the color blue that leads Isis to a story about how sometimes it was hard growing up with parents who believed in gender-neutral clothes and toys.
sentences.zh: 正是蓝色让艾西斯讲起了一个故事，关于在相信性别中立服装和玩具的父母身边长大有时是多么困难。

sentences.en: When Isis was eight, she told me, her parents agreed to buy her her first bike.
sentences.zh: 艾西斯告诉我，她八岁时，父母同意给她买第一辆自行车。

sentences.en: At the store, she found her dream bike.
sentences.zh: 在店里，她找到了她梦想中的自行车。

sentences.en: It was my favorite color of blue.
sentences.zh: 那是我最喜欢的蓝色。

sentences.en: And it had, like, the skirt bend in it.
sentences.zh: 而且它还有那种裙摆式的设计。

sentences.en: And I just wanted it so badly.
sentences.zh: 我太想要它了。

sentences.en: But my dad said no because my brother had been born.
sentences.zh: 但我爸爸说不行，因为我弟弟出生了。

sentences.en: Royce and Jessica believed in gender-neutral parenting for their son as well.
sentences.zh: 罗伊斯和杰西卡也相信对儿子进行性别中立的养育。

sentences.en: A boy with a blue bike?
sentences.zh: 一个骑蓝色自行车的男孩？

sentences.en: That would just be following the usual script.
sentences.zh: 那只会遵循通常的剧本。

sentences.en: Another thing Isis didn't mention is that the bike also had frills.
sentences.zh: 艾西斯没提到的另一件事是，那辆自行车还有花边。

sentences.en: Obviously, a no-go.
sentences.zh: 显然，这是不行的。

sentences.en: I was so mad.
sentences.zh: 我当时气坏了。

sentences.en: But, you know, moved on.
sentences.zh: 但你知道，后来也就释怀了。

sentences.en: Got a bike that had a blue stripe on it.
sentences.zh: 买了一辆带蓝色条纹的自行车。

sentences.en: Which was okay.
sentences.zh: 那也还可以。

sentences.en: It was very devastating for an eight-year-old to not be able to get the bike that you wanted.
sentences.zh: 对于一个八岁的孩子来说，买不到想要的自行车是非常令人沮丧的。

sentences.en: But I can understand now.
sentences.zh: 但我现在能理解了。

sentences.en: Isis says it was sometimes painful to be raised in a gender-neutral way.
sentences.zh: 艾西斯说，以性别中立的方式长大有时会很痛苦。

sentences.en: Because I had to tell people that I wasn't a boy.
sentences.zh: 因为我不得不告诉别人我不是男孩。

sentences.en: And sometimes people wouldn't believe me when I said that I wasn't a boy.
sentences.zh: 有时当我告诉别人我不是男孩时，他们还不相信。

sentences.en: Especially children, which was ridiculous.
sentences.zh: 尤其是小孩子，这太荒谬了。

sentences.en: With her dad looking on, I asked Isis,
sentences.zh: 在父亲的注视下，我问艾西斯，

sentences.en: whether it had been too much.
sentences.zh: 这是否太过分了。

sentences.en: Did you feel like your parents ever went too far?
sentences.zh: 你觉得你父母有没有做得太过火的时候？

sentences.en: I'm just curious.
sentences.zh: 我只是好奇。

sentences.en: You're putting on the pressure.
sentences.zh: 你在给我施加压力。

sentences.en: You sound like someone who can deal with pressure.
sentences.zh: 你听起来像是一个能应对压力的人。

sentences.en: Yes, that's why I did my breathy voice.
sentences.zh: 是的，这就是我刚才用那种气声说话的原因。

sentences.en: But, um, I don't know.
sentences.zh: 但是，嗯，我不知道。

sentences.en: I can't think of a specific time where it was like that.
sentences.zh: 我想不出有什么具体的时候是那样的。

sentences.en: But I think that I've, I think that they gave me the freedom that I needed.
sentences.zh: 但我认为，他们给了我所需要的自由。

sentences.en: And I've never, they've never said blatantly, no, you cannot wear this.
sentences.zh: 他们从来没有直截了当地说，不，你不能穿这个。

sentences.en: Or no, you can absolutely not do this.
sentences.zh: 或者不，你绝对不能做这个。

sentences.en: And I can't, yeah, I think it's been generally pretty good.
sentences.zh: 我想总的来说还是挺好的。

sentences.en: Mainly, the stories that come tumbling out of Isis tell of a girl who lives her life with determination.
sentences.zh: 艾西斯讲述的故事主要展现了一个充满决心生活的女孩。

sentences.en: She grew up climbing trees and digging worms for their chickens and helping her younger siblings.
sentences.zh: 她从小就爬树、为家里的鸡挖蚯蚓，并帮助弟弟妹妹。

sentences.en: She's also surprisingly candid about her gender and her sexuality.
sentences.zh: 她对自己的性别和性取向也出奇地坦诚。

sentences.en: When we sat down for our interview, like I do with all guests, I asked Isis to introduce herself.
sentences.zh: 当我们坐下来采访时，像对待所有嘉宾一样，我请艾西斯做个自我介绍。

sentences.en: Here's what she said.
sentences.zh: 她是这样说的。

sentences.en: I'm Isis James Carnes.
sentences.zh: 我是艾西斯·詹姆斯·卡恩斯（Isis James Carnes）。

sentences.en: I'm 16 years old.
sentences.zh: 我16岁。

sentences.en: My pronouns are she, her, and hers.
sentences.zh: 我的代词是她（she, her, hers）。

sentences.en: Um, I identify sexually as bisexual.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我的性取向是双性恋。

sentences.en: It was a powerful moment.
sentences.zh: 那是一个震撼的时刻。

sentences.en: Isis seems to know who she is.
sentences.zh: 艾西斯似乎很了解自己。

sentences.en: She is a girl, and yet, she doesn't seem at all confined by traditional gender constraints.
sentences.zh: 她是个女孩，然而，她似乎完全没有受到传统性别束缚的限制。

sentences.en: She can like boys and girls.
sentences.zh: 她可以喜欢男孩，也可以喜欢女孩。

sentences.en: She is comfortable in riding boots and in high heels.
sentences.zh: 她穿骑行靴和高跟鞋都很自在。

sentences.en: She can be herself.
sentences.zh: 她可以做真实的自己。

sentences.en: So, one of the things that has fascinated me, and I've been always wondering as I talked with your parents,
sentences.zh: 所以，有一件事让我很着迷，我在和你们父母交谈时一直很好奇，

sentences.en: is, I mean, you've obviously turned into a wonderful young woman.
sentences.zh: 我是说，你显然已经成长为一位出色的年轻女性。

sentences.en: You're self-confident.
sentences.zh: 你很自信。

sentences.en: You're, you know, you're happy.
sentences.zh: 你，你知道，你很幸福。

sentences.en: You're cheerful.
sentences.zh: 你很开朗。

sentences.en: You explore things.
sentences.zh: 你喜欢探索事物。

sentences.en: I mean, you are every parent's dream child.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你是每个父母梦寐以求的孩子。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: I'm wondering, would you have turned out differently if they had parented you differently?
sentences.zh: 我在想，如果他们用不同的方式养育你，你会不会变得不一样？

sentences.en: Or is it just, is it possible this is just who Isis is?
sentences.zh: 还是说，有没有可能这就是艾西斯本来的样子？

sentences.en: This is actually not Royce and Jessica's doing.
sentences.zh: 这其实并不是罗伊斯和杰西卡的功劳。

sentences.en: This is actually all you.
sentences.zh: 这其实全是你自己的原因。

sentences.en: Well, this turns into nature versus nurture, which is a very complicated and highly arguable idea that is through a lot of what we do.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这涉及到了先天与后天的争论，这是一个非常复杂且极具争议的观点，贯穿了我们所做的大部分事情。

sentences.en: And so, me personally, I believe that everyone has something that is totally your own.
sentences.zh: 所以，就我个人而言，我相信每个人都有一些完全属于自己的东西。

sentences.en: What I say is one-third I got from my dad, one-third I got from my mom, and one-third is all me.
sentences.zh: 我的说法是，三分之一来自我爸爸，三分之一来自我妈妈，还有三分之一完全是我自己。

sentences.en: And yet, when you think about all of the ways in which the world shapes us,
sentences.zh: 然而，当你想到世界塑造我们的所有方式时，

sentences.en: I think we are increasingly realizing that it's really difficult to disentangle the part of us that feels most like us that comes from us and the part of us that feels most like us that comes from the outside.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们越来越意识到，真的很难区分我们身上那些感觉最像自己的部分，究竟是源于我们自身，还是源于外界。

sentences.en: And that they both feel exactly the same.
sentences.zh: 而且它们感觉起来完全一样。

sentences.en: They feel like this is who I am.
sentences.zh: 它们感觉就像这就是我。

sentences.en: And what we don't realize is that this is who I am can partly be a social construction, and it can partly be a biological construction,
sentences.zh: 我们没有意识到的是，这种“这就是我”在某种程度上可能是一种社会建构，也可能是一种生物学建构，

sentences.en: and it can partly be a combination of those two things in ways that are quite unpredictable.
sentences.zh: 它也可能是这两者的结合，以一种相当不可预测的方式。

sentences.en: And the question I want to ask you is, when your parents say, we want her to be who she is, we want her to become who she wants to be, I've always wondered,
sentences.zh: 我想问你的是，当你的父母说“我们希望她成为她自己，我们希望她成为她想成为的人”时，我一直很好奇，

sentences.en: does that assume that there is a person that we want to be outside of those social influences?
sentences.zh: 这是否假设了在这些社会影响之外，还存在一个我们想要成为的人？

sentences.en: Do you see what I'm saying?
sentences.zh: 你明白我的意思吗？

sentences.en: In other words, is there really something that is genuinely uncontaminated by the outside world that if we allow all of the outside world to be held at bay,
sentences.zh: 换句话说，是否真的存在某种完全未受外界污染的东西，如果我们让外界的一切都保持距离，

sentences.en: that will come and flower up?
sentences.zh: 它就会自然而然地绽放出来？

sentences.en: Or is it actually the case that everything we are is actually shaped by the outside world, and gender-neutral parenting is a choice just like any other choice,
sentences.zh: 还是说，事实上我们的一切都是被外界塑造的，性别中立的育儿方式也只是众多选择中的一种，

sentences.en: and it's going to shape things that you feel are truly intrinsic to yourself that might, in fact, be the product of your environment?
sentences.zh: 它会塑造出你认为真正内在的东西，而这些东西实际上可能是你环境的产物？

sentences.en: Um, cause and effect is everything, so, you know, it's, I think, me personally, I believe, for me to be myself, to even have the concept of self,
sentences.zh: 嗯，因果关系就是一切，所以，你知道，我认为，就我个人而言，我相信，为了成为我自己，甚至为了拥有自我的概念，

sentences.en: I need something that is inherently and undividedly, undiluted me, that's just me, and it will always be just me.
sentences.zh: 我需要一些本质上、不可分割、纯粹属于我的东西，那只是我，而且永远都只是我。

sentences.en: As their family has grown, Jessica and Royce have tried to maintain their beliefs.
sentences.zh: 随着家庭成员的增加，杰西卡和罗伊斯一直试图坚持他们的信仰。

sentences.en: They still homeschool all their kids.
sentences.zh: 他们仍然让所有的孩子在家自学。

sentences.en: They still buy clothes and toys that defy stereotypes and encourage exploration.
sentences.zh: 他们依然购买那些打破刻板印象并鼓励探索的衣服和玩具。

sentences.en: It's gotten easier in some ways.
sentences.zh: 在某些方面，这变得更容易了。

sentences.en: There are more choices now, more parents doing what they do.
sentences.zh: 现在的选择更多了，也有更多的父母在做他们所做的事情。

sentences.en: But Royce says they have also become less confrontational.
sentences.zh: 但罗伊斯说，他们也变得不那么具有对抗性了。

sentences.en: It's almost like when you first become vegetarian, you are somewhat militant, right?
sentences.zh: 这就像你刚开始吃素的时候，会有点激进，对吧？

sentences.en: And then after a while, you just start to mellow out, and, cause you're just, you can only be so militant.
sentences.zh: 过了一段时间，你就会开始变得温和，因为你不可能一直那么激进。

sentences.en: And so that definitely happened.
sentences.zh: 所以这种情况确实发生了。

sentences.en: The way we interacted with people became less militant, and I don't even think that we were trying to be militant in the beginning.
sentences.zh: 我们与人互动的方式变得不那么激进，而且我甚至不认为我们一开始是想变得激进。

sentences.en: It just, that's just the way, where we were.
sentences.zh: 这只是，这就是我们当时的状态。

sentences.en: For her part, Jessica says, she spent a lot of time reflecting on the early days with ISIS.
sentences.zh: 至于杰西卡，她说她花了很多时间反思与艾西斯在一起的早期时光。

sentences.en: She feels strongly they were doing the right thing, but she regrets how quickly they walked away from those who didn't understand what they were trying to do, especially family.
sentences.zh: 她坚信他们做的是正确的事，但她后悔当初太快远离那些不理解他们意图的人，尤其是家人。

sentences.en: Things are much better now, but for a long time, they weren't.
sentences.zh: 现在情况好多了，但在很长一段时间里，情况并非如此。

sentences.en: Sometimes we were maybe too, we didn't change what we did, but we just kind of said, all right, that's your choice, you know?
sentences.zh: 有时我们可能太……我们没有改变我们的做法，但我们只是说，好吧，那是你的选择，你知道吗？

sentences.en: And I think sometimes staying in relationship is staying in there when it, in those hard conversations for longer.
sentences.zh: 我认为有时保持关系意味着在遇到困难的对话时，要坚持更久一点。

sentences.en: And that's what I, I wish that I had, um, had the courage to do.
sentences.zh: 而那正是我希望我当时有勇气去做的事情。

sentences.en: But what they did do also took courage.
sentences.zh: 但他们所做的事情也需要勇气。

sentences.en: They were, in a way, pushing against the tide.
sentences.zh: 在某种程度上，他们是在逆流而上。

sentences.en: When you do make a change, you feel the system respond to that change, and sometimes fiercely.
sentences.zh: 当你做出改变时，你会感觉到系统对这种改变的反应，有时甚至是猛烈的。

sentences.en: After our chat, ISIS and her family head to the National Museum of African American History and Culture.
sentences.zh: 聊天结束后，艾西斯和她的家人前往国家非裔美国人历史文化博物馆。

sentences.en: At the exhibit commemorating the Greensboro Four, Royce pauses.
sentences.zh: 在纪念“格林斯伯勒四人组”的展览前，罗伊斯停下了脚步。

sentences.en: Come on, guys.
sentences.zh: 来吧，孩子们。

sentences.en: This is, this is your great uncle.
sentences.zh: 这是，这是你们的叔祖父。

sentences.en: You need to come and see.
sentences.zh: 你们需要过来看看。

sentences.en: He gathers his children around him.
sentences.zh: 他把孩子们聚拢在身边。

sentences.en: Oh, yes, that's your great uncle right there.
sentences.zh: 哦，是的，那就是你们的叔祖父。

sentences.en: And he says, I had the most wonderful feeling.
sentences.zh: 他说，我当时有一种最美妙的感觉。

sentences.en: I had a feeling of liberation, restored manhood.
sentences.zh: 我有一种解放感，恢复了男子气概。

sentences.en: I had a natural high, and I truly felt almost invincible.
sentences.zh: 我有一种自然的快感，我真的感觉自己几乎是不可战胜的。

sentences.en: Mind you, I was just sitting on a dumb stool and not having asked for service yet.
sentences.zh: 请记住，我当时只是坐在一个愚蠢的凳子上，还没有要求服务。

sentences.en: It's Franklin McCain in 2009.
sentences.zh: 这是2009年的富兰克林·麦凯恩。

sentences.en: That's just before he died.
sentences.zh: 那是在他去世前不久。

sentences.en: Royce and Jessica are idealists.
sentences.zh: 罗伊斯和杰西卡是理想主义者。

sentences.en: They're also stubborn people who can come across to critics as rigid and dogmatic.
sentences.zh: 他们也是固执的人，在批评者眼中可能显得死板和教条。

sentences.en: Maybe you've met people like this in your own life.
sentences.zh: 也许你在生活中也遇到过这样的人。

sentences.en: They make it difficult to go about business as usual.
sentences.zh: 他们让一切照常进行变得困难。

sentences.en: They can make a big deal over seemingly small issues and then stick to their positions with maddening ferocity.
sentences.zh: 他们会为了看似微小的问题大做文章，然后以令人抓狂的执着坚持自己的立场。

sentences.en: But when you think about how a culture evolves, it's because of people like Royce and Jessica.
sentences.zh: 但当你思考一种文化是如何演变的时候，正是因为有了像罗伊斯和杰西卡这样的人。

sentences.en: People who wake up one morning and decide they're going to be the change they want to see.
sentences.zh: 那些某天早上醒来，决定要成为他们想看到的改变的人。

sentences.en: Our unsung hero today is Camilla Smith.
sentences.zh: 我们今天的无名英雄是卡米拉·史密斯。

sentences.en: Camilla is a member of the NPR Foundation Board of Trustees,
sentences.zh: 卡米拉是NPR基金会董事会的成员，

sentences.en: and she has been an early and vocal supporter of Hidden Brain.
sentences.zh: 她是《Hidden Brain》早期且直言不讳的支持者。

sentences.en: She's the very definition of an unsung hero.
sentences.zh: 她就是无名英雄的定义。

sentences.en: Camilla loves to work without drawing attention to herself,
sentences.zh: 卡米拉喜欢在不引人注意的情况下工作，

sentences.en: sees far more than she lets on,
sentences.zh: 她看到的远比她表现出来的要多，

sentences.en: and is always generous with her encouragement.
sentences.zh: 而且总是慷慨地给予鼓励。

sentences.en: Every time I meet her, I feel more energized about my work.
sentences.zh: 每次见到她，我都对自己的工作感到更有活力。

sentences.en: Thanks, Camilla.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，卡米拉。
